title: Transport operator console
subtitle: Scan passenger tickets and get paid instantly. Cancel a service and every passenger is refunded automatically.
noDeployment: Booking is not available on this network yet.
connect: Connect your operator wallet to manage services and passengers
loadError: Couldn't load data from the blockchain. Check your connection and try again.

notOperator.title: This wallet isn't a registered operator
notOperator.body: Wallet {address} is not on the operator list, so it can't check passengers in or cancel services.
notOperator.howTo: Switch to a demo operator wallet as described in the README, then come back to this page.

emptyBody: When people book your services, they will show up here.
noShowHint: No-show payment can be claimed 2 hours after departure.

cancel.title: Cancel this service?
cancel.body: Every passenger gets a full refund automatically, right away. They don't need to do anything.
cancel.confirm: Cancel and refund {n, plural, one {# passenger} other {# passengers}}
cancel.done: Cancelled. {n, plural, one {# passenger was} other {# passengers were}} refunded automatically, {refund} in total

scan.title: Scan QR to check in
scan.body: Point the camera at the QR in the passenger's app. We confirm they really hold the ticket.
scan.cameraError: Couldn't open the camera. Allow camera access, or paste the QR text / ticket number below.
scan.manual: Or paste QR text / ticket number
scan.noSignature: No signature from the holder ({holder}). Check the ticket in the passenger's app before checking in.

problem.parse: Can't read this QR. It isn't a Wayfare ticket.
problem.wrongChain: This ticket is on a different network.
problem.notYours: This ticket isn't for your service.
problem.notBooked: This ticket was already used, cancelled or refunded.
problem.badSignature: The signature doesn't match the ticket holder. The QR may be fake or the ticket was given away.
